faqs.question: What is the cost of the 100-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala?
faqs.answer: The 100-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala starts from $599 for tuition-only, $799 for a shared quad room, $999 for a double room, and $1,199 for a private room with attached private bath. All residential packages include your ashram room in Varkala Cliff, three daily Sattvic meals, study materials, sacred Arabian Sea Aarti excursions, and airport transfer support.

faqs.question: Is the 100-Hour course suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 100-Hour course is specifically crafted for beginner yogis, busy professionals, and dedicated practitioners who wish to experience authentic ashram life and deepen their personal practice without committing to the full 28-day schedule. No prior certifications or intense flexibility are required.

faqs.question: Can I convert my 100-Hour training into a 200-Hour RYT later?
faqs.answer: Yes! The 100-Hour curriculum covers the complete first half (Part 1) of our full 200-Hour syllabus. You can complete your second 100 hours within 12 to 24 months at either our Varkala or Bali ashram to receive your full Yoga Alliance RYT 200 certification without repeating any modules.

faqs.question: What certification do I receive upon finishing the 100-Hour course?
faqs.answer: Upon successful completion of the 12-day program, you will receive a YogaGarhi 100-Hour Foundation Yoga Immersion Certificate. While the 100-Hour certificate does not grant full RYT 200 status on its own, it provides certified continuing education and official academic credits toward your complete 200-Hour credential.

faqs.question: How long is the 100-Hour training?
faqs.answer: The 100-Hour course runs over 12 days and 11 nights, starting on the 1st of every month. The program provides an intensive, transformative experience covering traditional Hatha, Ashtanga, pranayama, meditation, philosophy, and basic anatomy.

faqs.question: Apakah Varkala tempat yang bagus untuk pelatihan guru yoga?
faqs.answer: Varkala terkenal di seluruh dunia sebagai destinasi spiritual utama di Kerala, terkenal dengan tebing merah megah, pantai Laut Arab yang tenang, dan tradisi penyembuhan Ayurveda berusia berabad-abad. Belajar yoga di sini menawarkan suasana pesisir yang damai dan menyembuhkan, bebas dari kebisingan dan gangguan, dengan energi pembersihan Pantai Papanasam yang suci.

faqs.question: Bagaimana cara menuju ashram di Varkala?
faqs.answer: Terbanglah ke Bandara Internasional Trivandrum (TRV), yang berjarak hanya 45 km (sekitar 1 jam perjalanan) dari ashram Varkala Cliff kami. Atau, tiba dengan kereta api di Stasiun Kereta Api Varkala Sivagiri (VAK), hanya berjarak 3 km (10 menit). Bantuan penjemputan bandara dapat dikoordinasikan berdasarkan permintaan.

faqs.question: Can I pay in installments?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can secure your enrollment with a modest deposit of $200 and pay the remaining balance upon your arrival at the ashram or via flexible payment milestones before the course commences.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: Course deposits are non-refundable but 100% transferable to any future batch in Varkala or Bali within 12 months, provided you notify us at least 14 days in advance.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year to visit Varkala?
faqs.answer: October through March offers the most pleasant weather (15–25°C) with clear skies and brisk morning mountain air. April to June is warmer with vibrant river activities, while July to September brings serene monsoon greenery and deep contemplative study.

faqs.question: What meals are provided during the course?
faqs.answer: You will enjoy three freshly prepared, organic vegetarian Sattvic meals daily, tailored to Ayurvedic guidelines to nourish your body, calm the nervous system, and support rigorous daily physical asana practice.

faqs.question: What is the batch size for the 100-Hour course?
faqs.answer: We maintain an intimate batch size of 8–10 students to guarantee personalized attention, postural adjustments, and meaningful direct engagement with our experienced Himalayan masters.

faqs.question: Do you provide airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team can arrange direct airport pickup from Dehradun Jolly Grant Airport (DED) or New Delhi International Airport (DEL) right to our ashram doorstep in Varkala Cliff.

overview.heading: Selamat Datang di YogaGarhi Varkala
overview.story: Pelatihan Guru Yoga 100 Jam kami di Varkala adalah kursus residensial dasar 12 hari bagi siswa yang ingin membangun fondasi yogik yang kokoh. Terletak di Varkala Cliff, Kerala, di tepi Laut Arab yang suci, YogaGarhi menghadirkan pendalaman Hatha Klasik autentik, Ashtanga, pranayama, dan Ayurveda.
overview.p1: Terletak di sepanjang tebing Varkala yang menghadap ke Laut Arab, Pelatihan Guru Yoga 100 Jam kami di Kerala menawarkan pengenalan mendalam tentang kehidupan yogik tradisional dan kesehatan Ayurveda.
overview.p2: Di bawah bimbingan master berpengalaman dari India, Anda mempelajari yoga Hatha dan Ashtanga autentik, pranayama, meditasi, filosofi, dan anatomi dalam suasana ashram yang menghadap ke laut.

curriculum.heading: Rincian Modul & Topik Pembelajaran
curriculum.sub: Klik modul mana saja di bawah ini untuk menjelajahi rincian topik, teknik praktik, dan landasan teorinya.

detailedModules.title: Postur Ashtanga Yoga
items: Introduction to Ashtanga yoga followed by Sun salutation A & B
Standing sequence postures & use of yoga props

detailedModules.title: Filosofi Yoga
items: Introduction to Yoga Philosophy and its evolution
Introduction to yoga sutras of Patanjali

detailedModules.title: Praktik Pernapasan Pranayama
items: Introduction to Pranayama and its benefits

detailedModules.title: Pelafalan Suara Suci
items: Om Asato Maa Sadgamaya (Mantra from Upanishad)
Om Tryambakam Yajamahe (Mantra on Lord Shiva)

detailedModules.title: Anatomi dan Fisiologi
items: Joints and How to Protect them in Asanas
Anatomy of Ankle, Knee, Spine & Shoulder

detailedModules.title: Metodologi Pengajaran
items: Working with different level of students

detailedModules.title: Prinsip Penyelarasan & Penyesuaian
items: Fundamental principles of joint stacking, pelvic neutrality, and spine lengthening
Safe execution and anatomical alignment in foundational standing and seated poses
Effective use of props (blocks, straps, bolsters) to support safe practice
Identifying common postural habits and applying self-correction techniques

detailedModules.title: Hatha Yoga Tradisional
items: Classical Pawanmuktasana series 1, 2, and 3 for joint mobility and prana flow
Traditional Surya Namaskar variations with breath-synchronized awareness
Foundational standing, balancing, forward bending, and gentle twisting asanas
Principles of Sthira Sukham Asanam (cultivating steadiness and ease in each pose)

detailedModules.title: Fondasi Iyengar Yoga
items: Introduction to precision, geometry, and anatomical awareness in asanas
Prop-assisted alignment techniques using blocks, belts, and wall support
Building strength, stability, and postural endurance through extended holds
Safe alignment techniques for knee tracking, hip mobility, and spinal posture

detailedModules.title: Vinyasa Yoga Flow
items: Breath-synchronized movement connecting postures into fluid sequences
Step-by-step breakdown of Sun Salutation transitions and basic vinyasa waves
Coordinating conscious inhalation with heart openers and exhalation with folds
Cultivating mind-body rhythm, fluid grace, and conscious breath awareness

prakritiResearch.heading: Riset Sachin Ji tentang Yoga Personal dan Prakriti
prakritiResearch.quote: “Yoga bukan pendekatan satu ukuran untuk semua, karena setiap tubuh membawa energi yang berbeda”
prakritiResearch.card1Text: Saat studi Master Yoga guru utama kami, muncul pertanyaan yang tak terhindarkan: Mengapa latihan yang sama menenangkan sebagian orang, namun membuat yang lain merasa lelah atau gelisah?
prakritiResearch.card2Text: Hal ini melahirkan riset mendalam pada naskah yoga klasik, Ayurveda, dan pengalaman nyata bersama siswa. Jawabannya nyata: setiap manusia terlahir dengan Prakriti yang unik.
prakritiResearch.card3Text: Prakriti membentuk fisik, pikiran, emosi, dan sistem saraf. Sebagian butuh ketenangan, sebagian butuh gerak dinamis, dan sebagian butuh keheningan. Gaya seragam bisa memicu ketidakseimbangan.
prakritiResearch.card4Text: Lebih dari sekadar nama aliran yoga, yang terpenting adalah bagaimana Anda berlatih: bagaimana sistem saraf didekati, nafas dipandu, dan Dosha Anda dirawat tanpa dipaksakan.
prakritiResearch.card5Text: Dari kesadaran ini lahirlah Shiv–Shakti Sadhana, pendekatan seimbang yang menyelaraskan stabilitas dan aliran energi. Asana di sini menjadi fondasi kekuatan yang membumi.
prakritiResearch.card6Text: Ketika yoga menghormati Prakriti Anda, latihan menjadi alami, berkelanjutan, dan memulihkan. Yoga sejati tidak mengubah siapa Anda; ia mengembalikan harmoni dalam diri Anda.
prakritiResearch.conclusion1: Guru utama kami mengamati bahwa ketika latihan tidak selaras dengan sistem saraf dan tipe energi alami, postur yang tampak benar sekalipun dapat memicu kelelahan batin.
prakritiResearch.conclusion2: “Ketika yoga selaras dengan Prakriti Anda, manfaatnya dapat dirasakan secara berkelanjutan dan memulihkan. Di sini yoga tidak dipaksakan: ia personal, sadar, dan menghargai diri Anda.”

cards.title: Postur Ashtanga Yoga
cards.content: Rangkaian lengkap seri primer Ashtanga Yoga. Peningkatan bertahap melalui Surya Namaskar A & B, postur berdiri, postur duduk, dan latihan gaya Mysore.

cards.title: Hatha & Vinyasa Flow
cards.content: Seri Pawanmuktasana, variasi Surya Namaskar, postur berdiri dan duduk, lengkungan ke belakang, lipatan ke depan, inversi, dan penyusunan urutan kelas.

cards.title: Filosofi Yoga
cards.content: Pengantar Yoga Sutra Patanjali, delapan pilar Ashtanga Yoga, Nadis, Cakra, Pancha-Vayus, Panchakoshas, Triguna, serta kisah teladan para yogi agung.

cards.title: Pranayama & Pernapasan
cards.content: Teknik pernapasan lengkap: Ujjayi, Bhastrika, Kapalbhati, Nadi-Sodhana, Bhramari, Surya-Bhedi, Chandra-Bhedi, Sheetali, dan Sheetkari.

cards.title: Anatomi & Fisiologi
cards.content: Bidang gerak tubuh, perlindungan persendian, anatomi pergelangan kaki, lutut, tulang belakang, bahu, mekanisme pernapasan, dan sistem saraf.

cards.title: Metodologi Pengajaran
cards.content: Penyusunan urutan kelas, penyesuaian postur, pengelolaan berbagai tingkatan siswa, teknik intonasi suara, kesiapan mental, dan perencanaan kelas terstruktur.

cards.title: Meditasi & Mantra
cards.content: Berbagai teknik meditasi, pelafalan mantra suci, Trataka, Meditasi Dinamis Osho, Nada Brahma, Antar Mouna, dan latihan keheningan batin.

cards.title: Iyengar Yoga
cards.content: Yoga berbasis presisi anatomi menggunakan alat bantu seperti balok, tali, dan selimut guna mencapai keselarasan postur optimal serta mencegah cedera.

cards.title: Prinsip Keselarasan
cards.content: Pondasi latihan yang aman: penataan sendi, pola aktivasi otot, dan biomekanika tubuh guna melindungi serta memperkuat fisik secara menyeluruh.

cards.title: Bandhas (Kunci Energi)
cards.content: Kuasai Mula, Uddiyana, dan Jalandhara Bandha untuk mengalirkan energi prana, menguatkan inti tubuh, dan memperdalam kualitas meditasi.

cards.title: Mudras (Gestur Suci)
cards.content: Gerakan suci tangan dan tubuh guna mengarahkan energi vital, mempertajam konsentrasi, serta terhubung dengan kesadaran yang lebih mendalam.

faqs.question: What is the cost of 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala?
faqs.answer: The 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala starts from $999 for tuition-only, $1,299 for a shared quad room, $1,499 for a twin-sharing double room, and $1,799 for a private room with attached bathroom. All residential packages include your room in Varkala Cliff, three daily Sattvic Ayurvedic meals, study manuals, Yoga Alliance certification, sacred Arabian Sea excursions, and complimentary airport pickup assistance.

faqs.question: Apakah Varkala tempat yang bagus untuk pelatihan guru yoga?
faqs.answer: Varkala terkenal di seluruh dunia sebagai destinasi spiritual utama di Kerala, terkenal dengan tebing merah megah, pantai Laut Arab yang tenang, dan tradisi penyembuhan Ayurveda berusia berabad-abad. Belajar yoga di sini menawarkan suasana pesisir yang damai dan menyembuhkan, bebas dari kebisingan dan gangguan, dengan energi pembersihan Pantai Papanasam yang suci.

faqs.question: Do I need prior yoga experience to join the 200-Hour YTT?
faqs.answer: No prior teaching experience or advanced flexibility is required. Our 200-Hour curriculum is designed to systematically build your practice from foundational principles to intermediate mastery. Furthermore, every enrolled student receives immediate access to our complimentary Pre-YTTC online preparation modules so you can build strength, mobility, and Sanskrit familiarity before arriving at the ashram.

faqs.question: Is the 200-Hour certification internationally recognized by Yoga Alliance?
faqs.answer: Yes, YogaGarhi is a registered Yoga Alliance school (RYS 200, RYS 300, RYS 500). Upon successful completion of our 200-Hour training in Varkala, you will receive an internationally accredited certificate that qualifies you to register as a Registered Yoga Teacher (RYT 200) and teach legally in any country worldwide.

faqs.question: Bagaimana cara menuju ashram di Varkala?
faqs.answer: Terbanglah ke Bandara Internasional Trivandrum (TRV), yang berjarak hanya 45 km (sekitar 1 jam perjalanan) dari ashram Varkala Cliff kami. Atau, tiba dengan kereta api di Stasiun Kereta Api Varkala Sivagiri (VAK), hanya berjarak 3 km (10 menit). Bantuan penjemputan bandara dapat dikoordinasikan berdasarkan permintaan.

faqs.question: Can I pay my course fees in installments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans to ease your financial planning. You can secure your seat in your chosen batch with a small advance deposit of $200–$300, and settle the remaining course tuition either in installments prior to arrival or on the official check-in day at the ashram campus.

faqs.question: What is the refund and cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We understand that life plans can change unexpectedly. While reservation deposits are non-refundable due to limited cohort caps (8–10 students), they are 100% transferable. If you need to postpone, you can transfer your deposit to any future Varkala or Bali batch within 12 months with at least 14 days prior notice at zero extra charge.

faqs.question: Kapan waktu terbaik dalam setahun untuk mengunjungi Varkala?
faqs.answer: Musim paling ideal untuk pelatihan yoga di Varkala adalah antara Oktober dan Maret, saat suhu siang hari berkisar 26–30°C dengan semilir angin laut yang sejuk, kelembapan nyaman, dan cuaca pantai yang cerah.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 100-Hour, 200-Hour, and 300-Hour YTT?
faqs.answer: The 100-Hour course (12 days) is an introductory immersion designed for beginners or time-constrained practitioners seeking deep personal transformation without full teaching credentials. The 200-Hour course (28 days) is the foundational international benchmark that qualifies you to teach as an RYT 200. The 300-Hour course (28 days) is an advanced master-level training for existing 200-Hour graduates aiming for the elite RYT 500 credential.

faqs.question: What styles of yoga are taught during the 200-Hour training?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive multi-style curriculum covers Classical Hatha Yoga, dynamic Ashtanga Vinyasa (Primary Series), modern Vinyasa Flow, and alignment principles inspired by B.K.S. Iyengar. You will also study pranayama breathwork, traditional meditation, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, applied biomechanics, and hands-on postural adjustments.

faqs.question: What is the daily schedule like at the Varkala ashram?
faqs.answer: A typical training day begins at 06.00 with herbal tea and morning cleansing kriyas, followed by pranayama and meditation at 06.30. Morning asana practice runs from 7:30 to 09.00, followed by a wholesome Ayurvedic breakfast. Midday sessions include Yoga Philosophy, Anatomy, and Alignment workshops, followed by lunch and rest. The afternoon continues with teaching methodology and evening Ashtanga, culminating in dinner at 19.30 and quiet reflection.

faqs.question: Apakah Varkala tempat yang bagus untuk pelatihan guru yoga?
faqs.answer: Varkala terkenal di seluruh dunia sebagai destinasi spiritual utama di Kerala, terkenal dengan tebing merah megah, pantai Laut Arab yang tenang, dan tradisi penyembuhan Ayurveda berusia berabad-abad. Belajar yoga di sini menawarkan suasana pesisir yang damai dan menyembuhkan, bebas dari kebisingan dan gangguan, dengan energi pembersihan Pantai Papanasam yang suci.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation and food is provided?
faqs.answer: Students stay in clean, comfortable rooms located within our Varkala Cliff ashram, featuring attached private bathrooms with 24/7 hot water, high-speed Wi-Fi, and air conditioning/heating. We serve three fresh, organic vegetarian and vegan Sattvic meals daily, prepared according to Ayurvedic principles with wholesome seasonal ingredients, digestive herbs, and herbal teas.

faqs.question: What should I pack for my yoga teacher training in Varkala?
faqs.answer: We recommend comfortable, breathable yoga clothing made from natural fibers, a light shawl or sweater for morning and evening meditation, slip-on shoes or sandals for ashram grounds, a refillable water bottle, personal toiletries, and an open heart. Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is recommended when visiting temples or walking along the holy Arabian Sea.

faqs.question: What is the batch size at YogaGarhi Varkala?
faqs.answer: We strictly limit our batches to 8–10 students maximum per cohort. While many commercial schools in Varkala accommodate 30 to 40 students per class, our intimate group size guarantees personalized attention, customized anatomical alignment feedback, and genuine mentorship from our master teachers.

faqs.question: What is YogaGarhi's Lifetime Free Re-attendance policy?
faqs.answer: Once you graduate from YogaGarhi, you are a member of our spiritual family for life. You can return to re-attend future batches of your completed course at either our Varkala or Bali campus completely tuition-free anytime in the future to refresh your knowledge and deepen your practice.

prakritiResearch.heading: Riset Sachin Ji tentang Yoga Personal dan Prakriti
prakritiResearch.quote: “Yoga bukan pendekatan satu ukuran untuk semua, karena setiap tubuh membawa energi yang berbeda”
prakritiResearch.card1Text: Saat studi Master Yoga guru utama kami, muncul pertanyaan yang tak terhindarkan: Mengapa latihan yang sama menenangkan sebagian orang, namun membuat yang lain merasa lelah atau gelisah?
prakritiResearch.card2Text: Hal ini melahirkan riset mendalam pada naskah yoga klasik, Ayurveda, dan pengalaman nyata bersama siswa. Jawabannya nyata: setiap manusia terlahir dengan Prakriti yang unik.
prakritiResearch.card3Text: Prakriti membentuk fisik, pikiran, emosi, dan sistem saraf. Sebagian butuh ketenangan, sebagian butuh gerak dinamis, dan sebagian butuh keheningan. Gaya seragam bisa memicu ketidakseimbangan.
prakritiResearch.card4Text: Lebih dari sekadar nama aliran yoga, yang terpenting adalah bagaimana Anda berlatih: bagaimana sistem saraf didekati, nafas dipandu, dan Dosha Anda dirawat tanpa dipaksakan.
prakritiResearch.card5Text: Dari kesadaran ini lahirlah Shiv–Shakti Sadhana, pendekatan seimbang yang menyelaraskan stabilitas dan aliran energi. Asana di sini menjadi fondasi kekuatan yang membumi.
prakritiResearch.card6Text: Ketika yoga menghormati Prakriti Anda, latihan menjadi alami, berkelanjutan, dan memulihkan. Yoga sejati tidak mengubah siapa Anda; ia mengembalikan harmoni dalam diri Anda.
prakritiResearch.conclusion1: Guru utama kami mengamati bahwa ketika latihan tidak selaras dengan sistem saraf dan tipe energi alami, postur yang tampak benar sekalipun dapat memicu kelelahan batin.
prakritiResearch.conclusion2: “Ketika yoga selaras dengan Prakriti Anda, manfaatnya dapat dirasakan secara berkelanjutan dan memulihkan. Di sini yoga tidak dipaksakan: ia personal, sadar, dan menghargai diri Anda.”

cards.title: Postur Ashtanga Yoga
cards.content: Rangkaian lengkap seri primer Ashtanga Yoga. Peningkatan bertahap melalui Surya Namaskar A & B, postur berdiri, postur duduk, dan latihan gaya Mysore.

cards.title: Hatha & Vinyasa Flow
cards.content: Seri Pawanmuktasana, variasi Surya Namaskar, postur berdiri dan duduk, lengkungan ke belakang, lipatan ke depan, inversi, dan penyusunan urutan kelas.

cards.title: Filosofi Yoga
cards.content: Pengantar Yoga Sutra Patanjali, delapan pilar Ashtanga Yoga, Nadis, Cakra, Pancha-Vayus, Panchakoshas, Triguna, serta kisah teladan para yogi agung.

cards.title: Pranayama & Pernapasan
cards.content: Teknik pernapasan lengkap: Ujjayi, Bhastrika, Kapalbhati, Nadi-Sodhana, Bhramari, Surya-Bhedi, Chandra-Bhedi, Sheetali, dan Sheetkari.

cards.title: Anatomi & Fisiologi
cards.content: Bidang gerak tubuh, perlindungan persendian, anatomi pergelangan kaki, lutut, tulang belakang, bahu, mekanisme pernapasan, dan sistem saraf.

cards.title: Metodologi Pengajaran
cards.content: Penyusunan urutan kelas, penyesuaian postur, pengelolaan berbagai tingkatan siswa, teknik intonasi suara, kesiapan mental, dan perencanaan kelas terstruktur.

cards.title: Meditasi & Mantra
cards.content: Berbagai teknik meditasi, pelafalan mantra suci, Trataka, Meditasi Dinamis Osho, Nada Brahma, Antar Mouna, dan latihan keheningan batin.

cards.title: Iyengar Yoga
cards.content: Yoga berbasis presisi anatomi menggunakan alat bantu seperti balok, tali, dan selimut guna mencapai keselarasan postur optimal serta mencegah cedera.

cards.title: Prinsip Keselarasan
cards.content: Pondasi latihan yang aman: penataan sendi, pola aktivasi otot, dan biomekanika tubuh guna melindungi serta memperkuat fisik secara menyeluruh.

cards.title: Bandhas (Kunci Energi)
cards.content: Kuasai Mula, Uddiyana, dan Jalandhara Bandha untuk mengalirkan energi prana, menguatkan inti tubuh, dan memperdalam kualitas meditasi.

cards.title: Mudras (Gestur Suci)
cards.content: Gerakan suci tangan dan tubuh guna mengarahkan energi vital, mempertajam konsentrasi, serta terhubung dengan kesadaran yang lebih mendalam.

faqs.question: What is the cost of 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala?
faqs.answer: The 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Varkala starts from $999 for tuition-only, $1,299 for a shared quad room, $1,499 for a twin-sharing double room, and $1,799 for a private room with attached bathroom. All residential packages include your room in Varkala Cliff, three daily Sattvic Ayurvedic meals, study manuals, Yoga Alliance certification, sacred Arabian Sea excursions, and complimentary airport pickup assistance.

faqs.question: Apakah Varkala tempat yang bagus untuk pelatihan guru yoga?
faqs.answer: Varkala terkenal di seluruh dunia sebagai destinasi spiritual utama di Kerala, terkenal dengan tebing merah megah, pantai Laut Arab yang tenang, dan tradisi penyembuhan Ayurveda berusia berabad-abad. Belajar yoga di sini menawarkan suasana pesisir yang damai dan menyembuhkan, bebas dari kebisingan dan gangguan, dengan energi pembersihan Pantai Papanasam yang suci.

faqs.question: Do I need prior yoga experience to join the 200-Hour YTT?
faqs.answer: No prior teaching experience or advanced flexibility is required. Our 200-Hour curriculum is designed to systematically build your practice from foundational principles to intermediate mastery. Furthermore, every enrolled student receives immediate access to our complimentary Pre-YTTC online preparation modules so you can build strength, mobility, and Sanskrit familiarity before arriving at the ashram.

faqs.question: Is the 200-Hour certification internationally recognized by Yoga Alliance?
faqs.answer: Yes, YogaGarhi is a registered Yoga Alliance school (RYS 200, RYS 300, RYS 500). Upon successful completion of our 200-Hour training in Varkala, you will receive an internationally accredited certificate that qualifies you to register as a Registered Yoga Teacher (RYT 200) and teach legally in any country worldwide.

faqs.question: Bagaimana cara menuju ashram di Varkala?
faqs.answer: Terbanglah ke Bandara Internasional Trivandrum (TRV), yang berjarak hanya 45 km (sekitar 1 jam perjalanan) dari ashram Varkala Cliff kami. Atau, tiba dengan kereta api di Stasiun Kereta Api Varkala Sivagiri (VAK), hanya berjarak 3 km (10 menit). Bantuan penjemputan bandara dapat dikoordinasikan berdasarkan permintaan.

faqs.question: Can I pay my course fees in installments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans to ease your financial planning. You can secure your seat in your chosen batch with a small advance deposit of $200–$300, and settle the remaining course tuition either in installments prior to arrival or on the official check-in day at the ashram campus.

faqs.question: What is the refund and cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We understand that life plans can change unexpectedly. While reservation deposits are non-refundable due to limited cohort caps (8–10 students), they are 100% transferable. If you need to postpone, you can transfer your deposit to any future Varkala or Bali batch within 12 months with at least 14 days prior notice at zero extra charge.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year to visit Varkala for yoga training?
faqs.answer: The ideal season to undertake your yoga training in Varkala is between October and March, when daytime temperatures average 15°C to 25°C with crisp Himalayan air, bright sunshine, and cool evenings. April to June brings warm sunshine and vibrant river energy, while July to September features the sacred monsoon season with lush green mountains and peaceful introspective study.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 100-Hour, 200-Hour, and 300-Hour YTT?
faqs.answer: The 100-Hour course (12 days) is an introductory immersion designed for beginners or time-constrained practitioners seeking deep personal transformation without full teaching credentials. The 200-Hour course (28 days) is the foundational international benchmark that qualifies you to teach as an RYT 200. The 300-Hour course (28 days) is an advanced master-level training for existing 200-Hour graduates aiming for the elite RYT 500 credential.

faqs.question: What styles of yoga are taught during the 200-Hour training?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive multi-style curriculum covers Classical Hatha Yoga, dynamic Ashtanga Vinyasa (Primary Series), modern Vinyasa Flow, and alignment principles inspired by B.K.S. Iyengar. You will also study pranayama breathwork, traditional meditation, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, applied biomechanics, and hands-on postural adjustments.

faqs.question: What is the daily schedule like at the Varkala ashram?
faqs.answer: A typical training day begins at 06.00 with herbal tea and morning cleansing kriyas, followed by pranayama and meditation at 06.30. Morning asana practice runs from 7:30 to 09.00, followed by a wholesome Ayurvedic breakfast. Midday sessions include Yoga Philosophy, Anatomy, and Alignment workshops, followed by lunch and rest. The afternoon continues with teaching methodology and evening Ashtanga, culminating in dinner at 19.30 and quiet reflection.

faqs.question: Apakah Varkala tempat yang bagus untuk pelatihan guru yoga?
faqs.answer: Varkala terkenal di seluruh dunia sebagai destinasi spiritual utama di Kerala, terkenal dengan tebing merah megah, pantai Laut Arab yang tenang, dan tradisi penyembuhan Ayurveda berusia berabad-abad. Belajar yoga di sini menawarkan suasana pesisir yang damai dan menyembuhkan, bebas dari kebisingan dan gangguan, dengan energi pembersihan Pantai Papanasam yang suci.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation and food is provided?
faqs.answer: Students stay in clean, comfortable rooms located within our Varkala Cliff ashram, featuring attached private bathrooms with 24/7 hot water, high-speed Wi-Fi, and air conditioning/heating. We serve three fresh, organic vegetarian and vegan Sattvic meals daily, prepared according to Ayurvedic principles with wholesome seasonal ingredients, digestive herbs, and herbal teas.

faqs.question: What should I pack for my yoga teacher training in Varkala?
faqs.answer: We recommend comfortable, breathable yoga clothing made from natural fibers, a light shawl or sweater for morning and evening meditation, slip-on shoes or sandals for ashram grounds, a refillable water bottle, personal toiletries, and an open heart. Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is recommended when visiting temples or walking along the holy Arabian Sea.

faqs.question: What is the batch size at YogaGarhi Varkala?
faqs.answer: We strictly limit our batches to 8–10 students maximum per cohort. While many commercial schools in Varkala accommodate 30 to 40 students per class, our intimate group size guarantees personalized attention, customized anatomical alignment feedback, and genuine mentorship from our master teachers.

faqs.question: What is YogaGarhi's Lifetime Free Re-attendance policy?
faqs.answer: Once you graduate from YogaGarhi, you are a member of our spiritual family for life. You can return to re-attend future batches of your completed course at either our Varkala or Bali campus completely tuition-free anytime in the future to refresh your knowledge and deepen your practice.

overview.heading: Selamat Datang di YogaGarhi Varkala

Terletak di sepanjang tebing Varkala, Kerala yang menakjubkan, menghadap ke Laut Arab, program ini memperdalam latihan Anda melalui asana lanjutan, pranayama, meditasi, terapeutik, dan filosofi tradisional.
overview.p1: Pelatihan Guru Yoga 300 Jam kami di Varkala memberikan pelatihan tingkat lanjut dan autentik yang berakar pada tradisi yogik klasik India dan ilmu Ayurveda. Tinggal dan belajar menghadap ke Laut Arab yang damai di pesisir Kerala.
overview.p2: Master pengajar berpengalaman kami membimbing Anda melalui Hatha dan Ashtanga Vinyasa lanjutan, anatomi energi halus, penyesuaian lanjutan, yoga sutra Patanjali, dan pengurutan terapeutik agar Anda lulus sebagai guru yang percaya diri dan berhak mendaftar sertifikasi RYT 500.

prakritiResearch.heading: Riset Sachin Ji tentang Yoga Personal dan Prakriti
prakritiResearch.quote: “Yoga bukan pendekatan satu ukuran untuk semua, karena setiap tubuh membawa energi yang berbeda”
prakritiResearch.card1Text: Saat studi Master Yoga guru utama kami, muncul pertanyaan yang tak terhindarkan: Mengapa latihan yang sama menenangkan sebagian orang, namun membuat yang lain merasa lelah atau gelisah?
prakritiResearch.card2Text: Hal ini melahirkan riset mendalam pada naskah yoga klasik, Ayurveda, dan pengalaman nyata bersama siswa. Jawabannya nyata: setiap manusia terlahir dengan Prakriti yang unik.
prakritiResearch.card3Text: Prakriti membentuk fisik, pikiran, emosi, dan sistem saraf. Sebagian butuh ketenangan, sebagian butuh gerak dinamis, dan sebagian butuh keheningan. Gaya seragam bisa memicu ketidakseimbangan.
prakritiResearch.card4Text: Lebih dari sekadar nama aliran yoga, yang terpenting adalah bagaimana Anda berlatih: bagaimana sistem saraf didekati, nafas dipandu, dan Dosha Anda dirawat tanpa dipaksakan.
prakritiResearch.card5Text: Dari kesadaran ini lahirlah Shiv–Shakti Sadhana, pendekatan seimbang yang menyelaraskan stabilitas dan aliran energi. Asana di sini menjadi fondasi kekuatan yang membumi.
prakritiResearch.card6Text: Ketika yoga menghormati Prakriti Anda, latihan menjadi alami, berkelanjutan, dan memulihkan. Yoga sejati tidak mengubah siapa Anda; ia mengembalikan harmoni dalam diri Anda.
prakritiResearch.conclusion1: Guru utama kami mengamati bahwa ketika latihan tidak selaras dengan sistem saraf dan tipe energi alami, postur yang tampak benar sekalipun dapat memicu kelelahan batin.
prakritiResearch.conclusion2: “Ketika yoga selaras dengan Prakriti Anda, manfaatnya dapat dirasakan secara berkelanjutan dan memulihkan. Di sini yoga tidak dipaksakan: ia personal, sadar, dan menghargai diri Anda.”

studentStories.heading: Hati yang Berkelimpahan di YogaGarhi
studentStories.sub: "Dengarkan langsung penuturan tulus dari para praktisi yang telah menjalani perjalanan transformasi ini."

stories.name: Gurpreet Kaur Dhou
stories.quote: YogaGarhi memegang teguh esensi sejati yoga tradisional. Sejak awal, saya merasa dihargai dan didampingi secara personal. Para pengajar dengan tulus membimbing perkembangan Anda hingga menemukan karakter mengajar Anda sendiri.

stories.name: Ilksen Doğan
stories.quote: Sachin Ji adalah salah satu guru yoga paling berwawasan luas yang pernah mengajar saya. Meskipun saya seorang pemula, kesabaran dan dorongannya membuat saya memahami keselarasan asana dengan penuh percaya diri.

stories.name: Aleksandra Dyachenko
stories.quote: Pelatihan 200 jam di Bali benar-benar luar biasa. 🌺 Pengetahuan yang diajarkan sangat mendalam dan autentik. Para guru mengajar dari hati dengan penuh ketulusan dan kebijaksanaan layaknya keluarga besar yang hangat.

stories.name: Amy Letourneau
stories.quote: Sachin Ji adalah pengajar dan pribadi yang luar biasa. Pelatihan di Bali ini menjadi awal perjalanan yoga berharga yang mengantarkan saya percaya diri mengajar di berbagai penjuru dunia.

stories.name: Lisa Beltman
stories.quote: Saya sangat mengagumi ketenangan, keramahan, dan kehangatan Sachin Ji. Beliau sangat berilmu dan senantiasa meluangkan waktu membimbing setiap siswa secara teliti.

stories.name: Nicole Drake
stories.quote: Pengalaman transformatif yang amat berkesan di YogaGarhi Bali. Kelompok belajar kecil memberikan manfaat maksimal, setiap koreksi postur terasa personal. Saya merasa sangat siap untuk mengajar.

yogaGarhiDifference.title: Perbedaan YogaGarhi
yogaGarhiDifference.subtitle: Bagaimana filosofi pengajaran sadar kami, batasan peserta yang ketat, metode diagnostik Ayurveda, dan garis keturunan Himalaya membedakan kami secara nyata dari pusat pelatihan komersial.

pillars.title: Grup Kecil: Maksimal 8–10 Siswa
pillars.description: Sementara sebagian besar institusi yoga komersial di Rishikesh menjejalkan 25 hingga 35 siswa ke dalam satu aula besar, YogaGarhi secara ketat membatasi setiap angkatan hanya 8 hingga 10 praktisi. lingkungan yang akrab ini memungkinkan para guru master kami mengamati napas, penyelarasan postur, dan keterlibatan otot Anda di setiap asana. Anda menerima umpan balik anatomi tatap muka setiap hari, penyesuaian postur sesuai struktur tubuh unik Anda, dan bimbingan mendalam untuk setiap pertanyaan spiritual Anda.

pillars.title: Yoga Personal Berbasis Prakriti
pillars.description: Kami menolak sekuens kaku satu ukuran untuk semua yang berisiko mencederai siswa. Mengacu pada Ayurveda klasik dan terapi yoga, pengajar senior kami mengevaluasi Prakriti unik Anda—keseimbangan bawaan dosha Vata, Pitta, dan Kapha. Anda belajar memodifikasi asana, rasio pranayama, dan meditasi harian demi menyelaraskan energi pribadi. Anda lulus dengan keahlian langka merancang sekuens yoga terapeutik yang aman untuk segala usia dan tipe tubuh.

pillars.title: Master Himalaya E-RYT 500
pillars.description: Di YogaGarhi, Anda belajar langsung di bawah bimbingan master Himalaya yang dipimpin oleh Sachin Ji dan fakultas senior kami. Para pengajar berpredikat E-RYT 500, bergelar pascasarjana Ilmu Yoga, dan berpengalaman puluhan tahun dalam tradisi gurukul. Memadukan tradisi sakral dengan anatomi fungsional modern dan biomekanika, mereka membekali Anda dengan integritas dan wawasan mendalam.

pillars.title: Persiapan Online Pra-YTTC
pillars.description: Perjalanan transformasi Anda dimulai begitu pendaftaran dikonfirmasi. Anda langsung memperoleh akses seumur hidup ke portal video persiapan online Pra-YTTC kami. Modul ini membimbing Anda dalam pelafalan Sanskerta, penyelarasan asana dasar, teknik pernapasan, dan mobilisasi sendi. Anda tiba di ashram Tapovan dengan tubuh bugar, pikiran tenang, dan siap menyelami materi secara maksimal sejak hari pertama.

pillars.title: Gratis Mengulang Seumur Hidup
pillars.description: Hubungan kita tidak berakhir saat sertifikat kelulusan diserahkan. Sebagai alumni YogaGarhi, Anda menjadi bagian dari sangha spiritual global kami seumur hidup. Kami memberikan jaminan mengulang kursus gratis seumur hidup: Anda dapat kembali mengikuti angkatan berikutnya dari kursus yang telah diselesaikan baik di kampus Rishikesh maupun Bali tanpa biaya kursus tambahan. Pintu kami selalu terbuka untuk Anda.

yogaGarhiDifferenceVarkala.subtitle: Bagaimana kuota terbatas kami, penilaian Prakriti Ayurveda personal, shala tepi pantai, dan dukungan seumur hidup meningkatkan kualitas pelatihan Anda.

pillars.title: Shala Tebing & Pantai dengan Prana Samudra
pillars.description: Shala yoga kami bertengger di atas Laut Arab di antara lambaian pohon kelapa, dengan deburan ombak sebagai metronom alami Anda. Udara pesisir memurnikan pernapasan, memperdalam pranayama, dan menenangkan sistem saraf. Dari Surya Namaskar saat fajar di dek tebing hingga meditasi tanpa alas kaki di Pantai Papanasam, menyatu dengan alam memperkaya latihan Anda.

pillars.title: Imersi Ayurveda Kerala & Panchakarma
pillars.description: Berada di tempat kelahiran historis Ayurveda, kurikulum kami memberikan pemahaman mendalam tentang pengobatan klasik. Pelajari Dinacharya (rutinitas harian), Ritucharya (gaya hidup musiman), dasar diagnosis nadi, dan khasiat herba seperti Brahmi serta Ashwagandha, lengkap dengan pengalaman terapi Abhyanga dan Kizhi dari praktisi tradisional berlisensi.
